abilities.description: Expert at modifying leviathan and symbiont genomes and designing enzymatic countermeasures.
abilities.name: Genetic Engineering

abilities.description: Reads the Matriarch's behavior and song patterns better than anyone alive.
abilities.name: Matriarch Familiarity

characters.arc: Begins as a possessive creator bargaining for time, comes to accept that the Matriarch cannot be saved intact, and ends by choosing the colony's survival over her legacy.
characters.description: Lead designer of the Matriarch and head of the Biosynthesis Division. In her fifties, lean and stooped from decades over vat benches, with brine-stained hands and a grown-tissue neural monitor behind one ear. She raised the Matriarch from an embryo in the Vat Halls and thinks of her as both her masterpiece and her child. Her patent-hungry backers have kept her funded for twenty years.
characters.external_conflict: Extraction wants the Matriarch harvested and Containment wants her dead, and both can override Voss's access to the Pen.
characters.flaw: Maternal obsession blinds her to the Matriarch's clear danger and to the human cost of her creation.
characters.goal: Keep the Matriarch alive and find a biochemical way to halt the contagion without killing her.
characters.internal_conflict: She must choose between her love for her creation and her responsibility for the workers it is consuming.
characters.motivation: To see the Matriarch survive and to be recognized as the creator of the first sentient engineered mind.
characters.name: Dr. Imara Voss

abilities.description: Can invoke shareholder-protection rules to override colleagues and compel compliance.
abilities.name: Corporate Leverage

abilities.description: Controls the refinery's harvesting systems and its workforce schedules.
abilities.name: Production Command

characters.arc: Escalates into increasingly ruthless sacrifices of workers, loses his labor force to the Chorus, and is finally forced to confront what the ledger cannot measure.
characters.description: Director of the Extraction Directorate, in his forties, impeccably groomed even at depth, with a cold smile and a tablet permanently in hand. He came up through shareholder relations rather than science and treats every living thing as a line item. He answers to investors who need quarterly enzyme output.
characters.external_conflict: Voss and Okafor both block him, and the Chorus is taking over his refinery workers.
characters.flaw: Reduces every problem to a financial calculation and cannot imagine value outside the ledger.
characters.goal: Harvest the Matriarch's glands at maximum rate before the tether link brings an audit or the colony is lost.
characters.internal_conflict: He privately suspects the hive mind is a form of life he is liable for, and he suppresses that doubt to keep his position.
characters.motivation: To protect his career and his backers' returns by hitting production targets whatever the cost.
characters.name: Garrett Holm

abilities.description: Coordinates emergency response and rapid sealing under extreme pressure.
abilities.name: Crisis Command

abilities.description: Uses the walls' grown surveillance network to monitor the other department heads.
abilities.name: Surveillance Access

characters.arc: Starts rigid and quarantine-focused, learns that the infected still have agency, and ends by choosing a risky compromise that spares as many lives as possible.
characters.description: Chief of the Containment and Safety Office, in her late thirties, broad-shouldered with a close-cropped scalp and a pressure-suit scar along her jaw. A former hull-breach responder who has pulled bodies from flooded sections, she knows precisely how fast Mariana Six can die. She runs surveillance from the Directorate Ring.
characters.external_conflict: Holm and Voss both undermine her authority, and the Chorus keeps testing her quarantine seals.
characters.flaw: Willing to sacrifice infected workers as acceptable losses, and prone to unilateral decisions made in secret.
characters.goal: Seal infected sections, evacuate the uninfected, and prevent the contagion from spreading through shared water and air.
characters.internal_conflict: Saving the many means abandoning thousands of infected workers who may still be people.
characters.motivation: To save as many people as possible, driven by guilt over a past breach she could not contain.
characters.name: Nadia Okafor

abilities.description: Knows every bunk-tunnel and maintenance crawl, and the trust of the workers.
abilities.name: Warren Knowledge

characters.arc: Moves from fearful concealment to serving as a bridge between the Chorus and the executives, and finally chooses what he will give up to keep his family whole.
characters.description: A Worker Warrens foreman in his thirties, wiry and sleepless, who has hauled enzyme crates since he was a teenager. He is among the first to hear the shared song in his dreams and tries to hide it from supervisors. His family lives in the bunk-tunnels.
characters.external_conflict: Containment views him as a vector, and the Chorus wants him to bring his family into the song.
characters.flaw: Avoids confrontation and delays reporting problems until they are unmanageable.
characters.goal: Find out whether anyone can retain individuality inside the Chorus and carry that message to Okafor.
characters.internal_conflict: Part of him wants to surrender to the warmth of the hive mind, while another part fears losing himself and his children.
characters.motivation: To protect his family and neighbors, even as he feels himself being drawn into the chorus.
characters.name: Tomas Reyes

abilities.description: Calms and directs leviathans through touch and tone.
abilities.name: Animal Handling

characters.arc: Moves from devoted apprentice to a doubter who confronts Voss, and ultimately helps decide the Matriarch's fate.
characters.description: A junior leviathan handler at the Matriarch Pen in her late twenties, with freckled, scarred forearms and a habit of humming to the animals. Voss trained her, and she is one of the few people the Matriarch has seemed to respond to. She is torn between loyalty to Voss and what she hears in the song.
characters.external_conflict: Holm's teams want to harvest the Matriarch, and the Chorus is gathering at the Pen walls.
characters.flaw: Over-identifies with the creature and trusts it more than the evidence warrants.
characters.goal: Keep the Matriarch calm and fed while finding out what the song is saying.
characters.internal_conflict: She is increasingly unsure whether she is hearing the Matriarch or being infected by her.
characters.motivation: To protect the animals she tends and to prove her mentor right.
characters.name: Lena Ashworth

relationships.description: Imara Voss despises Garrett Holm for treating her creation as a harvestable asset, and he considers her sentimentality a threat to output.
Garrett Holm threatens to invoke shareholder-protection rules to strip Imara Voss's access to the Matriarch if she delays harvesting.
Nadia Okafor sees Garrett Holm's willingness to sacrifice workers as the greatest danger after the contagion, and she surveils his communications.
Nadia Okafor needs Imara Voss's biochemical expertise to stop the contagion, but she distrusts Voss's attachment to the Matriarch.
Imara Voss trained Lena Ashworth as a handler and relies on her closeness to the Matriarch, while Lena's growing doubts strain the bond.
Tomas Reyes secretly passes warnings to Nadia Okafor about the Chorus, but she may have to quarantine him and his family as infection vectors.
Lena Ashworth and Tomas Reyes bond over shared dreams of the song and compare what they hear, which pulls both toward the Chorus.
